from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CourtFee(BaseModel):
    """A record of a specific court fee mentioned in the document."""
    level: str | None = Field(description="The litigation stage associated with the fee (e.g., 一审，二审，再审)")
    amount: str | None = Field(description="The exact amount of the fee, including currency units if present")
    payer: str | None = Field(description="The party or parties responsible for paying this fee")

class DocumentExtraction(BaseModel):
    """The structured information extracted from a single legal document needed to match it to a specific judgment result."""
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="The specific case number of the legal document (e.g., (2023) 辽 01 执异 9 号)")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="The nature of the case or procedure (e.g., 民事二审，执行复议，再审审查)")
    parties: list[str] = Field(description="The names of the parties involved (appellant, appellee, applicant, respondent, etc.)")
    disposition_summary: str | None = Field(description="The core decision or ruling outcome described in the document")
    court_fees: list[CourtFee] = Field(description="A list of court fee details found in the document, useful for matching against result amounts")
    unique_entities: list[str] = Field(description="Any other unique names or specific identifiers mentioned that aid in matching")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentExtraction]
